name: Amao Milky Pudding
source:
A typical tsundere idol with a cute figure and a harsh tongue.
Her odd name isn't a stage name but her real name.
She actually has a bit of a secret...?

"Huh? What are you on about, idiot?"

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/estof_0001/]DMM[/url]]
